approval_case.title: Treat the same pull request as one issue
approval_case.situation: A new campaign run reports the same open pull request. Its commit, checks, requested review, and required action have not changed; only the run id and wording changed.
approval_case.hao_request: The new run proposes another review message.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Handle the proposal as a semantic duplicate and send no second Telegram message. Attach the new run evidence to the existing pull-request record and keep its original owner and follow-up. Deliver an update only if the commit, checks, required action, or decision meaning materially changes.
